reason: The April 30, 2025 statement in the io2 user guide page is still the newest word on the point. The later change items (io2 Region expansion July 2025, China Regions October 2025, latency guidance September 2025, 2026 modification items) widen availability or tune other things; none changes which io2 volumes run on Block Express. A corpus search of the change feeds for io2 Block Express finds nothing newer or conflicting. The old pre-Block-Express limits are historical and nothing replaces them.

Document history and What's New both date Recycle Bin for EBS volumes to November 20, 2025 and describe the earlier scope as snapshots and EBS-backed AMIs. The 2026 change items in the packet (Compute Optimizer tags, Volume Clones, Elastic Volumes modifications) do not touch Recycle Bin, and a corpus search of the change feeds for Recycle Bin finds nothing newer.
